thread:
Harper: Hey folks — two quick things: I accepted Director of Product today :tada: and the adoption paperwork for our daughter was finalized this morning. We;re officially a family of three!! Wanted to share because I;m thrilled and thinking a small office catch-up next Friday around lunch would be lovely.

Jules: OMG HARPER!!! That is amazing on both counts :party_popper::heart_eyes: so happy for you.

Ben: Incredible news :raised_hands: big congrats to you and your family. Lunch next Friday works for me.

Mei: This is the best update of the week. I can bring dumplings and a tiny welcome banner.

Oscar: Congrats!! I;ll DJ (aka Spotify playlist) and bring paper plates. Also quick poll: snacks — savory or sweet? Reply with emoji.

Harper: Wow thanks y;all. Poll: 

9c0 savory

36a sweet

Jules: 9c0

Ben: 36a

Mei: 9c0 (dumplings = savory win)

Oscar: 9c0 but also a few cupcakes for the kids.

Harper: Looks like savory wins. Dumplings + finger sandwiches it is. I;ll add a small cake just for the office.

HR Bot: Event created: https://calendar.company.internal/e/1923456789-harper-welcome-lunch (Fri Jun 21  12:30-1:15pm) :calendar: Please RSVP.

Ben: If folks want to write 1 line for a card to baby and Harper, paste them here and I;ll print it out.

Jules: "Harper ; Your family just got a whole lot brighter. Congrats on the new title and tiny human!"

Mei: "Welcome to your little one — so much love to you three. Proud of you for everything, Harp!"

Oscar: "Huge congrats. Dinner/playlist on me next week. Let me know cake flavor."
